cohort: Pregnant mothers delivering at SNMMCH in Dhanbad, Jharkhand, India, divided into teenage (14-19 years) and older (20-29 years) age groups.
finding: Teenage pregnancies were significantly associated with unfavorable fetal outcomes including low birth weight, low 5-min Apgar score, and preterm newborns, as well as perineal tears for the mother.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was not significantly linked to teenage pregnancies.
cross-section timing: Data collected around the time of delivery through prospective and retrospective phases.
